== English Reflections II comparison ==
Decipher's older ruling addresses announcing an Interrupt play. The July 2007 Appendix A publishes the replacement 7 side and states that it is played as if from hand. The front stays the same. Lost Pile origin, the once-per-turn limit, removal from play, Force, smuggler, and flip provisions remain.

[https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=113 July 2007 Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1, p. 113]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20010613012725id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgsupplement053001.pdf#page=12 Decipher 30 May 2001 declaration ruling, p. 12].
